errors.evidence: Description uses '言语文明' instead of the correct label '语言文明' as shown in the figure and atom checklist.
Description describes the color as '浅黄色' (light yellow), but the atom checklist and figure show the color as '黄色' (yellow).
Description describes the color as '深绿色' (dark green), but the atom checklist and figure show the color as '绿色' (green).
Description describes the color as '浅灰白色' (light gray-white), but the atom checklist and figure show the color as '白色' (white).
The description does not explicitly state the purpose of the chart as showing the proportion distribution of four different civilization categories. It uses a vague term '文明-行为类'.
